About the stories & artwork

Books are sourced from Project Gutenberg: Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland, Moby-Dick, and Dracula. These editions are listed as public domain in the United States; rights can vary elsewhere.

Give My Regards to Black Jack — SHUHO SATO. Officially distributed artwork used under the distributor’s secondary-use terms.

Space Adventures #1: Charlton Publications, 1952; cover by Al Fago and Lou Morales. Scan by Chordboard, available under CC BY-SA 3.0; scaled for display. The underlying comic is documented as public domain in the US.
